name: lipsync_video
description: Put replacement audio on existing footage using sync-3 via fal by default. Requires measured video/audio durations, source fps, every face/voice subject and explicit consent_confirmed=true. Script only: create authorized ElevenLabs TTS first. All paid requests pause with a cost estimate even in autonomous runs. Large equal-length cut_off inputs require supplied silence/shot chunk boundaries plus ffmpeg and S3. Dry-run is an input preview. Poll get_video_task with download=true; never claim completion until the saved MP4 plays. No training eligibility.

video_url.description: Existing HTTPS video or renderhaus-asset:// version handle. Live handles must resolve through the authorized Studio asset resolver.

audio_url.description: Existing HTTPS speech audio or renderhaus-asset:// version handle. No new voice is generated.

source_duration_seconds.description: Measured whole-source duration, greater than zero and at most 600 seconds. Windowed sources are unsupported.

audio_duration_seconds.description: Measured positive finite duration of the speech audio in seconds. Sync mode determines output length.

source_fps.description: Measured positive finite video frame rate. Direct legacy-base pricing scales by frame count; fal pricing does not.

subjects.description: Identify the single speaker whose source voice is cloned and whose likeness appears.

consent_confirmed.description: Must be boolean true. Confirms explicit permission to clone the source voice and edit the depicted likeness.

sync_mode.description: cut_off uses the shorter input; loop, bounce and remap follow audio length; silence uses the longer input. Long chunked runs support equal-length inputs with cut_off only.

chunk_boundaries_seconds.description: Strictly increasing internal silence or shot timestamps. Required when either input exceeds SYNC_MAX_CHUNK_SECONDS. Every resulting span must fit the cap. fal's hard duration maximum is UNVERIFIED.

model.description: Configured model override. sync-3 is verified. Other identifiers are UNVERIFIED and allowed only in dry-run previews.

source_width.description: Optional measured input width in positive pixels, paired with source_height. No provider resolution setting is sent; single jobs inherit input dimensions and the current chunk concatenator produces 720p.

source_height.description: Optional measured input height in positive pixels, paired with source_width. Required with width to assess an explicitly requested output resolution.

name: get_video_task
description: Poll a saved Sync job or chunk manifest once; download=true persists completed MP4 media and provenance. Reuse the exact job_id, never submit another lip-sync job to check status. No paid generation. Dry-run never produces an artifact.

job_id.description: Exact saved Sync job handle from lipsync_video. Polling never submits another generation.

download.description: Save a completed MP4 atomically. Aggregate jobs always download completed children to concatenate their outputs.

name: transcribe_video
description: Transcribe a consented whole video already on assets.sync.so, at most 600 seconds and one speaker. Uses direct Sync even if regular lip-sync uses fal. No generation credit charge. Preserve transcription_id and poll get_transcription; dry-run produces no transcript.

source_video_url.description: Exact whole-source HTTPS URL on assets.sync.so. Upload the source through Sync's asset upload flow before using this tool.

source_duration_seconds.description: Measured whole-source duration, greater than zero and at most 600 seconds. Windowed sources are unsupported.

speaker_count.description: Must be integer 1. Multi-speaker dialogue edits are unsupported.

subjects.description: Identify the single speaker whose source voice is cloned and whose likeness appears.

consent_confirmed.description: Must be boolean true. Confirms explicit permission to clone the source voice and edit the depicted likeness.

name: get_transcription
description: GET an existing transcription for unchanged transcript, original word IDs and speaker metadata. Never creates another job. Dry-run produces no transcript; dry IDs cannot be used live.

transcription_id.description: Exact Sync transcription ID from transcribe_video. The provider fetches and forwards the original transcript unchanged.

name: create_dialogue_edit
description: Create a paid preview of 1-100 word changes/removals in the consented source-cloned voice using the unchanged fetched transcript. Requires cost approval even autonomously; preview price TODO/unknown unless operator-confirmed. Save action_id before submission. NEVER retry a lost create response: submission_unknown requires check status or ask user. Preserve dialogue_edit_id and poll get_dialogue_edit.

source_video_url.description: Exact whole-source HTTPS URL on assets.sync.so. Upload the source through Sync's asset upload flow before using this tool.

transcription_id.description: Exact Sync transcription ID from transcribe_video. The provider fetches and forwards the original transcript unchanged.

wordIds.description: Required contiguous word IDs for remove.

edits.description: 1 to 100 change or remove operations using original word IDs. Removals must be contiguous and operations must not overlap.

source_duration_seconds.description: Measured whole-source duration, greater than zero and at most 600 seconds. Windowed sources are unsupported.

speaker_count.description: Must be integer 1. Multi-speaker dialogue edits are unsupported.

subjects.description: Identify the single speaker whose source voice is cloned and whose likeness appears.

consent_confirmed.description: Must be boolean true. Confirms explicit permission to clone the source voice and edit the depicted likeness.

action_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this approved preview action. Reuse it after any interruption. A lost response never triggers another preview submission.

voice_id.description: Optional source-cloned voice ID from an earlier dialogue job for this exact source, with rerun_of_job_id. Foreign voice hints are ignored.

rerun_of_job_id.description: Optional prior dialogue job ID used to verify same-source voice reuse.

name: get_dialogue_edit
description: GET an existing dialogue preview. Open/listen to previewAudioUrl; COMPLETED_PARTIAL remains partial and requires explicit acceptance. Preserve previewDurationMs, source/rollout metadata and voiceId. GET may retry; never retry preview creation to check status.

dialogue_edit_id.description: Exact Sync dialogue edit ID from create_dialogue_edit.

name: create_dialogue_video
description: Generate sync-3 with dialogueEdit and the same original whole video, at most 600 seconds and one speaker. Requires voice/likeness consent, user-reviewed preview, measured matching preview duration/fps and a saved Idempotency-Key. Paid video always requires cost approval even autonomously. Retime-required falls back to regular lipsync with independent approved audio and separate cost approval. Poll existing get_video_task with download=true; preview and queued jobs cannot finish a video.

source_video_url.description: Exact whole-source HTTPS URL on assets.sync.so. Upload the source through Sync's asset upload flow before using this tool.

dialogue_edit_id.description: Exact Sync dialogue edit ID from create_dialogue_edit.

source_duration_seconds.description: Measured whole-source duration, greater than zero and at most 600 seconds. Windowed sources are unsupported.

source_fps.description: Measured positive finite video frame rate. Direct legacy-base pricing scales by frame count; fal pricing does not.

speaker_count.description: Must be integer 1. Multi-speaker dialogue edits are unsupported.

subjects.description: Identify the single speaker whose source voice is cloned and whose likeness appears.

consent_confirmed.description: Must be boolean true. Confirms explicit permission to clone the source voice and edit the depicted likeness.

preview_reviewed.description: Must be boolean true after the user listens to the completed preview audio.

preview_duration_seconds.description: Measured previewDurationMs divided by 1000, greater than zero and at most 600. The paid output estimate uses this duration.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this approved video generation, 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, tilde or hyphen.

accept_partial.description: True only after the user explicitly accepts COMPLETED_PARTIAL preview results and their reported failures.

source_width.description: Optional measured input width in positive pixels, paired with source_height. No provider resolution setting is sent; single jobs inherit input dimensions and the current chunk concatenator produces 720p.

source_height.description: Optional measured input height in positive pixels, paired with source_width. Required with width to assess an explicitly requested output resolution.
